name: Praise Helix
description: Twitch Plays Pokemon on top of your own buttons, on all eleven games: a virtual chat that mostly follows what you do, a little late, with noise, herders, trolls and the odd START riot. HELIX queues your own inputs too. It never presses A on RELEASE, never saves your game, stays out of settings and the Mod Manager, and holding START+SELECT turns it off.
